title: Relaxing Nashville Family Getaway, Sleeps 6
description:
Relax in this two-bedroom, two-bath Nashville home with room for up to six guests. The sleeping layout includes a king bed, a queen bed, a double bed, and a sofa bed. Enjoy a full kitchen, dedicated workspace, outdoor seating, and garage parking. This comfortable family-friendly stay gives you an easy home base for exploring Nashville.

The space
Ideally situated in Nashville, this lovely two-bedroom home is the picture-perfect setting for your next relaxing vacation with the people you love! Step inside to find a well-appointed interior dressed in comfortable furniture, attractive floors, and lots of natural light cascading in through broad windows. The living room includes a large flatscreen TV for watching your favorite movies and shows, and you can prepare delicious meals in the full kitchen. Serve your creations at the handsome dining table with partial bench seating for six or out on the furnished deck to enjoy an al-fresco dining experience. The private washer and dryer will ensure everyone looks their best during your stay, and the central AC will keep everything nice and cool. Have a little work to do while you're here? You'll have a work desk and chair available, and the free WiFi will make it easy for remote workers and students to perform some online research for those last-minute projects.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
